envelope.description: Add buildArgv's read-only branch and the stable-descriptor computation

body.title: Add buildArgv's read-only branch and the stable-descriptor computation
body.summary: Add a request.mode==='read-only' branch inside buildArgv (src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts:365) that emits exactly the two connector_insrc_* allow flags and no approval flag, plus a stableDescriptorHash function that hashes buildArgv's own output with --output-dir excluded, the binary's resolved content identity, the adapter's pinned env subset, and cwd.
acceptanceChecks: buildArgv's read-only branch emits exactly the two connector_insrc_* flags and no approval flag, for any approval value (read-only requests with an approval setting are already rejected upstream by startTurn)

stableDescriptorHash is identical across two calls differing only in --output-dir (confirmed: buildArgv mints a fresh mkdtemp() path into --output-dir on every call per vibe-adapter.ts:365-375,470,481-482)
stableDescriptorHash changes when the binary content identity, pinned env subset, or cwd changes

tests.name: stableDescriptorHash computation excluding outputDir and its hit/miss decision -- two calls differing only in outputDir still hit the cache
buildArgv's read-only branch emits exactly the two connector_insrc_* flags and no approval flag
the recorded argv matching buildArgv's own values exactly except outputDir
